However, one new independent classification error remains: MIT 6.046 is a single course but is currently marked course_sequence, and its classification reason falsely claims paired official identities.

offline_only.authority: Only the pinned snapshot, current registry, and current discovery script were read. Earlier audit reports were not used as authority.
offline_only.temporary_discovery: The current discovery script was run with --dry-run against the pinned snapshot; no registry, script, or course artifact was written.

method.nav_and_source: Independently walked the pinned mkdocs.yml, resolved every Markdown leaf within the snapshot, checked source existence, and compared source paths and leaf keys with the registry.
method.identity: Constructed independent identity records from source path stem, institution, explicit course number, guide heading, and guide body. Punctuation/legacy numeric spellings were treated as aliases; explicit cross-listed pairs were kept as one course with preserved alternate numbers; distinct source stems and distinct official sequence members were not merged.
method.target_type: A course_sequence requires explicit paired or sequential official identity evidence in the title or guide. A prerequisite, later course, technology pair, punctuation variant, or cross-listed alias is not sequence evidence.
method.direction: Used nav category as primary evidence and substantive guide title/body as refinement. Checked the specified CS168, neural-network, numerical-analysis, LLM/NLP, and collision-derived direction cases, then scanned all 119 targets for category/title direction mismatches.
method.reason_completeness: Every leaf must have a non-empty reason consistent with its type. True sequences must state sequence evidence and identity preservation; cross-listed pages must state alias preservation; a single course must not claim sequence evidence.
